resources.string_upd: Connect AI assistants, such as Claude or ChatGPT, to your account: in the assistant, add a connector with the MCP server URL below and sign in to this site when it asks. They work with your own content the way you can on the site. A developer tool that can't sign in uses an access token instead.

Connect AI assistants, such as Claude or ChatGPT, to your account: in the assistant, add a connector with the MCP server URL below and sign in to this site when it asks. As an operator, they also get the operator tools switched on in Studio > Agents > Tools, which can change anything on the site. A developer tool that can't sign in uses an access token instead.
